items.title: OneMain gets FDIC green light for ILC charter
items.why: An ILC charter gives a subprime installment lender a funding and product path that could reshape embedded lending partner options.
items.summary_ai: The FDIC approved OneMain's industrial loan company charter despite a CFPB order and opposition from state attorneys general.
items.take: An ILC charter gives a subprime installment lender a funding and product path that could reshape embedded lending partner options.
